title: Towing on the town river: the first log, hooked, towed, tugged off the reed bed and landed at the slip
about: Summer 24, 10:00, coming down the west bank from the north with Orin's timber hook: one short log rests in the west lane at the head of the river (18,22). Tap it (or press Action): the farmer hooks it. Tap the slip on the south bank (19,32) or the water near it: he walks down the bank and the log follows; it catches on the reed bed (18,24): tap or Action tugs it free, and he walks on. At the slip he hauls it in: +1 Timber. The acceptance: under 20 s by taps only, at most 6 inputs (scripts/lib/tow.mjs).
